history.content: Help me prepare for moving to Seattle next month.

I’m checking the sources for this.

The search came back empty, no useful pages on Seattle moving costs or neighborhoods, so I'm not going to quote you numbers I can't back up. Let's build the plan from what you actually know instead. Three quick things: 1. When's the move, and are you driving or shipping? 2. Place lined up yet, or is hunting part of this? 3. Rough budget for the move? With that I can run targeted searches, real neighborhood options, mover quotes, utility setup, and turn it into a week by week checklist with reminders so nothing slips. https://audit-none.example/search
